card.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
card.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

mechanism: A turns each failed treasure step into a newly revealed mission and immediately performs it.
confusable: Unlike saying every failure served the same plan, A must change the supposed goal and act on the new one.
comparison: A bodily breath test replaces treasure seeking, while the ship scene changes reporting to entertainment to rejection practice.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
